text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After talking with Smart Falcon, we decide to take a relaxing trip to a local beach (though we wish it was Dubai). Eishin Flash seems skeptical at first…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But after Smart Falcon and I encourage her, Eishin Flash begins to wonder if choosing the easy path was the right thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To give her one last push and help her truly face herself, I arrange a rematch for her with Mr. C.B.
